reading_rule: The surfaces overlap but do different jobs. Lean checks propositions; papers explain; Comparator checks selected statement/type parity and replay; Palomar is a separate editorial and registry review. No later surface widens the mathematical claim established by its source.

surfaces.authority_boundary: Papers explain the work and are not Lean proof authority.

surfaces.boundary: All eight covered Erdős problems remain open. Comparator checks exact Lean statements, configured axioms, and kernel acceptance; it does not assess novelty, significance, source fidelity, or whether any open problem is solved.
surfaces.review_status: self-assessed and agent-checked; no human mathematical peer review is claimed

surfaces.boundary: A prepared review unit is not a submission, Comparator verdict, Palomar review, registration, acceptance, endorsement, novelty assessment, peer review, or solution of an open problem.
